messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: packrat with binary packages only
parts:
I will be using a Shiny app with about 180 students this fall. Having everyone use the same package versions should help avoid a lot of problems. I stumbled onto miniCRAN and, at least in testing, it works as intended. A first script, run only by me, creates a local repo with binaries for windows and mac (see 1st link below). The shiny app is not in an R-package but is distributed simply as a set of code, data, and markdown files using a read-only dropbox folder. When students first start the app the appropriate binary packages in the local repo (i.e., in their own copy of the dropbox folder) are installed in the local user folder (see 2nd link below).

It is really nice that packrat is included in Rstudio. I would be interested in using it but I really *do not* want students to have to compile packages from source when binary packages are available. Perhaps this is an overly broad question but is it possible to achieve something like what I described above using Packrat? 

https://github.com/mostly-harmless/radiant/blob/master/radiant-miniCRAN/radiant-miniCRAN.R
https://github.com/mostly-harmless/radiant/blob/master/radiant-miniCRAN/dependencies.R

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: packrat with binary packages only
parts:
Hi Vincent,

I think something like this would be achievable, but we currently do not have the functionality to directly support this. Are you thinking that we would have packrat:

1. Work with miniCRAN, so that binaries are downloaded from that repository?
2. Prefer binary versions of CRAN packages, even if the version currently installed does not match the system installed version?

If packrat sees that the repository is set to use `miniCRAN`, then it should prefer downloading binary packages from that repo when possible on `packrat::init` or `packrat::restore`. I would imagine that using something like

    options(repos = c(CRAN = <pathToMiniCRAN>))

should help packrat look for binary packages in the right place; however we might need some more functionality in packrat so that it prefers binary packages on init (when the version of a package in the user library does not match that of the external repository).

Thanks,
Kevin

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: packrat with binary packages only
parts:
Thanks for the reply Kevin. miniCRAN is an R-package (https://github.com/andrie/miniCRAN) that I used to make it easier to distribute my app to students. Students sync a folder from dropbox and run a .app or .bat file to launch it. I would determine the packages version I have installed (windows and mac version) and ship them with the app on dropbox.

An ideal scenario would be something like the following. Once the application code has been tested I 'lock' the packages and the binary versions I have installed are copied automatically to a sub-folder within the application folder. At that point the equivalent binary versions for other OSs would be pulled down from CRAN unless I compiled some of them myself. Does that help you at all?
